svg.title: Caldova: officer chat with Content Understanding before indexing
svg.desc: Proposed two-officer Foundry IQ architecture. Each officer chats with their own native Foundry agent in Microsoft Teams, with retrieval from their own Foundry IQ knowledge base on Azure AI Search. A separate ingestion path is officer to Azure Portal to own Blob container to Azure Content Understanding custom analyzer to independent approval and private indexing to own Foundry IQ index. Custom analysis extracts structured fields and tables before indexing; it cannot approve content. AadiK and AndreL retain separate case and derived-data domains. This is a target architecture, not deployment proof.
svg.text: Talk to your case. Right in Teams.
Chat in Teams. Understand case documents before they reach the index.
Low-code by design. Separate case domains.

g.text: ASK NATURALLY. GET AN ANSWER WITH SOURCES.
Officer A case index + knowledge base

svg.text: Two officers. Two separate case domains. No shared case context.
